pages.title: YunLai Archery
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r I$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Bow$(br2)§lEffect: §r Bow draw time is shortened to about 0.45 seconds, arrow speed is increased by 15% and base damage by +1.$(br2)§lConflicts: §r Mutually exclusive with other YunLai bow enchantments.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades
